Experience is gained from killing Enemies. The amount of experience gained depends on the level of the enemies killed. Experience contributes to the Levels of characters and the levels of specialized Skills.

For the example first enemy (Skullen) in present state (Beta 0.7.0B) on The Forest Trail gives 6 experience points for kill.
